1: -module(simplex_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Stage-2c integration: a real **4-node DispersedSimplex committee over loopback QUIC**, with **failover**.
    4: Each validator runs in its own OS Erlang node (via `peer`, stdio-controlled, no Erlang distribution),
    5: with its own `quod_quic` listener on a distinct port and its own Ed25519 identity — so the `{log, Ns}`
    6: proposal / share / cert / complaint traffic between them is genuine loopback QUIC, exactly the
    7: deployment shape.
    8: 
    9: The lexicographically first validator is the sole `mode=create` genesis writer. Its height-1 genesis asserts
   10: all four founding validators' `peer_admitted` facts; the other three start as `mode=join`, pin that exact
   11: block hash, and derive the already-four-member committee from it. The leader for a protocol view **rotates**
   12: round-robin over the sorted set, so tests
   13: target the correct proposer per view. `commits_across_committee` proves a write commits everywhere;
   14: `follower_relays` proves a non-leader transparently relays a write to its exact target proposer;
   15: `leader_failover` kills the next slot's leader
   16: **before it proposes**, so the view can only advance by a `⅔` **complaint cert → next view** — after which
   17: each origin internally retargets its retained signed submission to the rotated proposer.
   18: `consensus_commits_with_ingress_down` closes every currently tracked ingress
   19: stream and proves the live `{log,Ns}` committee still finalizes a leader-local
   20: write without reopening relay transport.
   21: `over_fault_restart_recovers` uses an isolated second
   22: committee to stop two validators (`>f`), keeps the head stalled past Δ, restarts both from their existing
   23: logs, and proves live finality resumes without a namespace-wide reboot. `quorum(4)=3` tolerates one down
   24: in normal operation; the latter case validates liveness recovery after deliberately exceeding that bound,
   25: while each validator's durable vote journal preserves its own no-equivocation decisions across restart.
   26: The Byzantine safety assumption remains at most `f` faulty validators.
   27: """.
   28: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   29: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   30: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
   31: -import(quod_ct, [eventually/2, match_ok/1, ordinary_write_ok/1]).
   32: 
   33: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   34: -export([recovery_diagnostics/2]).
   35: -export([commits_across_committee/1, follower_relays/1,
   36:          consensus_commits_with_ingress_down/1,
   37:          burst_commits_without_busy/1,
   38:          byzantine_retract_rejected/1, byzantine_admit_rejected/1, leader_failover/1,
   39:          over_fault_restart_recovers/1, membership_survives_leader_loss/1]).
   40: 
   41: -define(NS, <<"simplex:2c">>).
   42: -define(PORTS, [15820, 15821, 15822, 15823]).   %% N=4 ⇒ quorum 3, tolerates 1 down (failover)
   43: -define(DELTA_MS, 4000).   %% Δ_timeout on each peer: comfortably above even the FIRST commit round over cold
   44:                            %% pairwise QUIC links (so a healthy view does not time out), well below the
   45:                            %% `eventually` budgets (so a genuinely stuck view advances within the test budget)
   46: 
   47: all() -> [commits_across_committee, follower_relays,
   48:           consensus_commits_with_ingress_down,
   49:           burst_commits_without_busy,
   50:           byzantine_retract_rejected, byzantine_admit_rejected, leader_failover,
   51:           over_fault_restart_recovers, membership_survives_leader_loss].
   52: 
   53: %%%===================================================================
   54: %%% suite setup: one 4-node committee, shared across the (ordered) tests
   55: %%%===================================================================
   56: 
   57: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   58:     Keys  = [quod_identity:generate() || _ <- ?PORTS],       %% [{Pubkey, Seed}]
   59:     Identities = maps:from_list(
   60:                    [{Pub, #{pubkey => Pub,
   61:                             key => quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed})}}
   62:                     || {Pub, Seed} <- Keys]),
   63:     Addrs = [{P, {"127.0.0.1", Port}} || {{P, _}, Port} <- lists:zip(Keys, ?PORTS)],
   64:     {Nodes, _BootModes, _GenesisHash} =
   65:         start_founding_committee(
   66:           ?NS, "sx_", ?PORTS, Keys, Addrs, Config, untracked),
   67:     [{nodes, Nodes}, {identities, Identities} | Config].
   68: 
   69: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   70:     _ = [catch peer:stop(Peer) || {Peer, _Pub} <- ?config(nodes, Config)],
   71:     ok.
   72: 
   73: %% Start one validator in its own OS node: its own identity (env), its own QUIC listener on Port, a fast
   74: %% Δ_timeout, and the resolver pre-seeded with every peer's pubkey→addr. `BootMode` is either the sole
   75: %% canonical creator or a join pinned to that creator's slot-1 hash. Returns {Peer, Pubkey}.
   76: start_member(Ns, NamePrefix, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Addrs, BootMode, Config) ->
   77:     Name = list_to_atom(NamePrefix ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
   78:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
   79:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io, args => ["-pa" | code:get_path()]}),
   80:     try
   81:         configure_member(
   82:           Peer, Ns, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Addrs, BootMode, Config)
   83:     catch
   84:         Class:Reason:Stack ->
   85:             _ = catch peer:stop(Peer),
   86:             erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
   87:     end.
   88: 
   89: configure_member(Peer, Ns, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Addrs, BootMode, Config) ->
   90:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
   91:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
   92:     KeyTerm = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
   93:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
   94:     Set(listen_port,      Port),
   95:     Set(node_addr,        {"127.0.0.1", Port}),   %% advertised endpoint (identity is node_pubkey, below)
   96:     Set(node_pubkey,      Pub),
   97:     Set(identity_key,     KeyTerm),
   98:     Set(identity_cert,    quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
   99:     Set(simplex_delta_ms, ?DELTA_MS),
  100:     DataDir = filename:join(
  101:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
  102:                 "data_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  103:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir, DataDir),
  104:     Set(foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(DataDir, "foreign-history")}),
  105:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  106:     %% pre-seed the pubkey→addr resolver for the OTHER validators (the first dial needs it; later
  107:     %% ones ride the link header).
  108:     _ = [peer:call(Peer, quod_quic, learn, [Pj, Addr]) || {Pj, Addr} <- Addrs, Pj =/= Pub],
  109:     BaseCfg = #{node_id => Pub,
  110:                 identity => #{pubkey => Pub, key => KeyTerm},
  111:                 data_dir => DataDir},
  112:     Cfg = namespace_boot_config(BootMode, Pub, Addrs, BaseCfg),
  113:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
  114:     {Peer, Pub}.
  115: 
  116: namespace_boot_config(create, Pub, Addrs, BaseCfg) ->
  117:     %% One canonical writer creates slot 1 with the complete validator set.
  118:     %% Every other founding validator obtains this exact block through join.
  119:     FoundingPeers =
  120:         [{Pj, Host, PeerPort}
  121:          || {Pj, {Host, PeerPort}} <- Addrs, Pj =/= Pub],
  122:     BaseCfg#{mode => create, committee => FoundingPeers};
  123: namespace_boot_config({join, GenesisHash, CreatorAddr}, _Pub, _Addrs, BaseCfg) ->
  124:     BaseCfg#{mode => join, genesis_hash => GenesisHash,
  125:              seed_peers => [CreatorAddr]}.
  126: 
  127: start_tracked_member(
  128:   Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config) ->
  129:     Node = start_member(
  130:              Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config),
  131:     put(over_f_nodes, [Node | case get(over_f_nodes) of undefined -> []; L -> L end]),
  132:     Node.
  133: 
  134: %% Start the one canonical creator first, read the anchor from its durable slot 1,
  135: %% then start every other founding validator through the normal pinned join path.
  136: %% `BootModes` is retained by pubkey so a later OS-node restart cannot accidentally
  137: %% turn a joiner into an independent creator.
  138: start_founding_committee(
  139:   Ns, NamePrefix, Ports, Keys, Addrs, Config, Tracking) ->
  140:     Specs = lists:zip(Ports, Keys),
  141:     {CreatorPort, {CreatorPub, _} = CreatorKey} =
  142:         canonical_creator(Specs),
  143:     Creator =
  144:         start_committee_member(
  145:           Tracking, Ns, NamePrefix, CreatorPort, CreatorKey,
  146:           Addrs, create, Config),
  147:     GenesisHash =
  148:         peer:call(
  149:           element(1, Creator), quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  150:     32 = byte_size(GenesisHash),
  151:     {ok, CreatorAddr} = maps:find(
  152:                           CreatorPub, maps:from_list(Addrs)),
  153:     JoinMode = {join, GenesisHash, CreatorAddr},
  154:     JoinSpecs =
  155:         [Spec || Spec = {_Port, {Pub, _Seed}} <- Specs,
  156:                  Pub =/= CreatorPub],
  157:     Joiners =
  158:         [start_committee_member(
  159:            Tracking, Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key,
  160:            Addrs, JoinMode, Config)
  161:          || {Port, Key} <- JoinSpecs],
  162:     Nodes = [Creator | Joiners],
  163:     true =
  164:         eventually(
  165:           fun() ->
  166:                   lists:all(
  167:                     fun({Peer, _Pub}) ->
  168:                             slot(Peer, Ns) =:= 1
  169:                     end, Nodes)
  170:           end, 30000),
  171:     BootModes =
  172:         maps:from_list(
  173:           [{CreatorPub, create}
  174:            | [{Pub, JoinMode} || {_Port, {Pub, _Seed}} <- JoinSpecs]]),
  175:     {Nodes, BootModes, GenesisHash}.
  176: 
  177: canonical_creator([_ | _] = Specs) ->
  178:     CreatorPub =
  179:         lists:min(
  180:           [Pub || {_Port, {Pub, _Seed}} <- Specs]),
  181:     hd([Spec || Spec = {_Port, {Pub, _Seed}} <- Specs,
  182:                 Pub =:= CreatorPub]).
  183: 
  184: start_committee_member(
  185:   tracked, Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config) ->
  186:     start_tracked_member(
  187:       Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config);
  188: start_committee_member(
  189:   untracked, Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config) ->
  190:     start_member(
  191:       Ns, NamePrefix, Port, Key, Addrs, BootMode, Config).
  192: 
  193: %%%===================================================================
  194: %%% tests
  195: %%%===================================================================
  196: 
  197: %% A write submitted to a slot's (rotating) leader commits across the whole committee, fact in every KB.
  198: commits_across_committee(Config) ->
  199:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  200:     %% The creator wrote one slot-1 block containing all four validator facts;
  201:     %% the other three joined that exact pinned block.
  202:     [ ?assertEqual(1, slot(Peer)) || {Peer, _} <- Nodes ],
  203:     ?assertMatch(
  204:        [_],
  205:        lists:usort(
  206:          [peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])
  207:           || {Peer, _} <- Nodes])),
  208:     ?assertMatch(
  209:        [_],
  210:        lists:usort(
  211:          [maps:get(committee_id, status(Peer))
  212:           || {Peer, _} <- Nodes])),
  213:     %% ONE write on the current view leader commits at material height 2. Retried because
  214:     %% quod_prolog answers {error,rebuilding} until its async post-boot replay marks ready; {error,rebuilding}
  215:     %% never reaches consensus, so retrying still yields exactly one committed write (no over-shoot).
  216:     {L2, _} = leader_peer(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Config),
  217:     ?assert(eventually(
  218:               fun() ->
  219:                       ordinary_write_ok(
  220:                         prove(L2, {assertz, {capital, france, paris}}))
  221:               end, 20000)),
  222:     %% the commit propagates: every node reaches height 2 and reads the fact from its OWN kb
  223:     [ begin
  224:           ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(Peer) >= 2 end, 15000)),
  225:           ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, {capital, france, {'X'}})) end, 10000))
  226:       end || {Peer, _} <- Nodes ],
  227:     Requested = [maps:get(requested_slot,
  228:                           peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS]), -1)
  229:                  || {Peer, _} <- Nodes],
  230:     ?assertEqual([0, 0, 0, 0], Requested),
  231:     Heights = lists:usort([slot(Peer) || {Peer, _} <- Nodes]),
  232:     ?assertEqual([2], Heights).
  233: 
  234: %% A write submitted to a non-leader is signed there, relayed with its exact
  235: %% target slot, committed once, and applied across the committee.
  236: follower_relays(Config) ->
  237:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  238:     H = synced_height(Nodes),
  239:     %% `first_seat` is either Floor or Floor+1. Choose an author that leads
  240:     %% neither so this case cannot accidentally collect locally if the floor's
  241:     %% proposal becomes visible between height sampling and append routing.
  242:     {FollowerPeer, _} = relay_only_origin(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Nodes),
  243:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _},
  244:                  prove(FollowerPeer,
  245:                        {assertz, {relayed, from_follower}})),
  246:     [ ?assert(eventually(
  247:                 fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, {relayed, {'X'}})) end,
  248:                 10000))
  249:       || {Peer, _} <- Nodes ],
  250:     ?assertEqual(H + 1, synced_height(Nodes)).
  251: 
  252: %% Relay transport is not a prerequisite for ordering. Establish and commit a
  253: %% real non-leader relay inside this case, then close its tracked ingress
  254: %% directions. Once every Simplex state has observed the DOWNs, commit a
  255: %% leader-local write using only the independent consensus streams. No relay
  256: %% stream should reopen.
  257: consensus_commits_with_ingress_down(Config) ->
  258:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  259:     %% Standalone execution has not run `commits_across_committee`: explicitly
  260:     %% finish recovery and establish the consensus mesh before measuring the
  261:     %% independent ingress channel. In an ordered run the relay probe may reuse
  262:     %% a legitimate ingress stream established by the preceding case.
  263:     WarmHeight = synced_height(Nodes),
  264:     {WarmLeaderPeer, _WarmLeaderPub} =
  265:         leader_peer(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Config),
  266:     WarmFact = {ingress_isolation_warmup, WarmHeight + 1},
  267:     ?assert(
  268:        eventually(
  269:          fun() ->
  270:                  ordinary_write_ok(
  271:                    prove(WarmLeaderPeer, {assertz, WarmFact}))
  272:          end, 20000)),
  273:     [begin
  274:          ?assert(
  275:             eventually(
  276:               fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, WarmFact)) end,
  277:               10000))
  278:      end || {Peer, _Pub} <- Nodes],
  279:     ?assertEqual(WarmHeight + 1, synced_height(Nodes)),
  280: 
  281:     H0 = synced_height(Nodes),
  282:     %% As in `follower_relays`, exclude both slots `first_seat` can choose.
  283:     {RelayOriginPeer, _RelayOriginPub} =
  284:         relay_only_origin(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Nodes),
  285:     RelayFact = {ingress_stream_probe, H0 + 1},
  286:     ?assertMatch(
  287:        {ok, _, _},
  288:        prove(RelayOriginPeer, {assertz, RelayFact})),
  289:     [begin
  290:          ?assert(
  291:             eventually(
  292:               fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, RelayFact)) end,
  293:               10000))
  294:      end || {Peer, _Pub} <- Nodes],
  295:     ?assertEqual(H0 + 1, synced_height(Nodes)),
  296:     ?assert(
  297:        eventually(
  298:          fun() -> relay_transport_total(Nodes) > 0 end,
  299:          5000)),
  300:     %% More than two relay ticks: the active stream must remain eligible after
  301:     %% pending/inflight cleanup, not merely survive long enough to carry one
  302:     %% frame before an allowlist sweep closes it.
  303:     timer:sleep(700),
  304:     ?assert(relay_transport_total(Nodes) > 0),
  305: 
  306:     %% Count and close the current generation in one state snapshot on each
  307:     %% node, then wait for all state machines to process every DOWN.
  308:     Closed = close_relay_transport(Nodes),
  309:     ?assert(lists:sum(Closed) > 0),
  310:     ?assert(
  311:        eventually(
  312:          fun() -> relay_transport_total(Nodes) =:= 0 end,
  313:          5000)),
  314:     H = synced_height(Nodes),
  315:     {LeaderPeer, _LeaderPub} = leader_peer(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Config),
  316:     Fact = {consensus_without_ingress, H + 1},
  317:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, prove(LeaderPeer, {assertz, Fact})),
  318:     [begin
  319:          ?assert(
  320:             eventually(
  321:               fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, Fact)) end, 10000))
  322:      end || {Peer, _Pub} <- Nodes],
  323:     ?assertEqual(H + 1, synced_height(Nodes)),
  324:     ?assertEqual(0, relay_transport_total(Nodes)).
  325: 
  326: %% A concurrent burst across every validator commits COMPLETELY with ZERO busy
  327: %% rejections: arrivals that miss a batch park in the bounded ingress queue and drain
  328: %% into following blocks instead of bouncing on a retry timer. This is the headline
  329: %% guarantee of the event-driven ingress work — the superseded ingress path
  330: %% rejected about 55% of burst appends and amplified them through timed relay recovery.
  331: burst_commits_without_busy(Config) ->
  332:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  333:     %% settle first (standalone-safe): one committed warmup write, readable on every
  334:     %% node, absorbs {error, rebuilding} so the burst measures ingress, not boot.
  335:     _ = synced_height(Nodes),
  336:     {WarmLeader, _} = leader_peer(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)), Config),
  337:     ?assert(eventually(
  338:               fun() ->
  339:                       ordinary_write_ok(
  340:                         prove(WarmLeader,
  341:                               {assertz, {burst_warmup, ready}}))
  342:               end,
  343:               20000)),
  344:     [ ?assert(eventually(
  345:                 fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, {burst_warmup, {'X'}})) end, 15000))
  346:       || {Peer, _} <- Nodes ],
  347:     BusyBefore = total_busy(Nodes),
  348:     H0 = synced_height(Nodes),
  349:     T0 = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond),
  350:     Parent = self(),
  351:     Writers =
  352:         [begin
  353:              Tag = {burst, NodeIx, I},
  354:              spawn(fun() ->
  355:                        R = writer_retry(Peer, {assertz, {burst_fact, NodeIx, I}}, 40),
  356:                        Parent ! {Tag, R}
  357:                    end),
  358:              Tag
  359:          end
  360:          || {NodeIx, {Peer, _}} <- lists:zip(lists:seq(1, length(Nodes)), Nodes),
  361:             I <- lists:seq(1, 10)],
  362:     [receive {Tag, R} -> ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, R)
  363:      after 60000 ->
  364:          ct:pal("burst stall — fleet state: ~p",
  365:                 [[{Pub, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS])}
  366:                   || {Peer, Pub} <- Nodes]]),
  367:          ct:fail({writer_timed_out, Tag})
  368:      end || Tag <- Writers],
  369:     %% every fact readable everywhere; not one busy was minted anywhere in the fleet
  370:     [ ?assert(eventually(
  371:                 fun() -> match_ok(prove(Peer, {burst_fact, 1, 1})) end, 15000))
  372:       || {Peer, _} <- Nodes ],
  373:     ?assertEqual(BusyBefore, total_busy(Nodes)),
  374:     Heights = lists:usort([slot(Peer) || {Peer, _} <- Nodes]),
  375:     ?assertEqual(1, length(Heights)),
  376:     %% round pacing over the burst: the local-cluster reference number for the
  377:     %% live fleet's ~250-500ms phases — local rounds much faster than production
  378:     %% convicts the environment; equally slow convicts the code, reproducibly here
  379:     ElapsedMs = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond) - T0,
  380:     Slots = hd(Heights) - H0,
  381:     ct:pal("burst pacing: ~p slots in ~pms (~.1f ms/round, ~.2f blocks/s)",
  382:            [Slots, ElapsedMs, ElapsedMs / max(1, Slots),
  383:             Slots * 1000 / max(1, ElapsedMs)]).
  384: 
  385: total_busy(Nodes) ->
  386:     lists:sum([maps:get(r_busy, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS]), 0)
  387:                || {Peer, _} <- Nodes]).
  388: 
  389: close_relay_transport(Nodes) ->
  390:     [peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, test_close_relay_transport, [?NS])
  391:      || {Peer, _Pub} <- Nodes].
  392: 
  393: relay_transport_total(Nodes) ->
  394:     lists:sum(
  395:       [Outbound + Inbound
  396:        || {Peer, _Pub} <- Nodes,
  397:           {Outbound, Inbound} <-
  398:               [peer:call(
  399:                  Peer, quod_simplex,
  400:                  test_relay_transport_counts, [?NS])]]).
  401: 
  402: %% Retry only outcomes that prove the write never entered usable custody.
  403: %% Slot closure, routing, overload, and ambiguity all fail the test.
  404: writer_retry(_Peer, _Goal, 0) -> {error, out_of_retries};
  405: writer_retry(Peer, Goal, N) ->
  406:     case prove(Peer, Goal) of
  407:         {ok, _, _} = Ok -> Ok;
  408:         {error, rebuilding} ->
  409:             timer:sleep(50),
  410:             writer_retry(Peer, Goal, N - 1);
  411:         {error, conflict_retry} ->
  412:             timer:sleep(50),
  413:             writer_retry(Peer, Goal, N - 1);
  414:         Other ->
  415:             Other
  416:     end.
  417: 
  418: %% A Byzantine leader injects a crafted `{propose, ...}` whose payload is a committee change its OWN
  419: %% run_proof never gated — the multi-validator membership defense (Slice C). The proposal passes the pure
  420: %% shape gate (one well-formed peer_admitted op, committee stays non-empty) so it REACHES the KB verdict,
  421: %% but each honest follower re-judges it against its own kb and REFUSES support, so it can never reach a
  422: %% notarizing quorum. The view advances by complaint quorum, the committee is unchanged, and the namespace still
  423: %% commits honest writes.
  424: %%
  425: %% Case 1 — a fabricated-address RETRACT of a founding validator (the retract-ejection the Slice A review flagged):
  426: %% the crafted op carries the victim's pubkey but a wrong Host/Port, so it would drop the victim from the
  427: %% validator-set projection while MISSING in the KB. The verdict's exact-clause check (`has_clause`) rejects
  428: %% it — no honest support, the view advances, the committee keeps all four.
  429: byzantine_retract_rejected(Config) ->
  430:     Nodes  = ?config(nodes, Config),
  431:     Victim = element(2, hd(Nodes)),   %% a real validator's pubkey, retracted with a WRONG address
  432:     Evil   = tx([{retract, {{peer_admitted, Victim, "wrong-host", 9999, Victim}, true}}]),
  433:     assert_membership_proposal_skipped(Config, Evil).
  434: 
  435: %% Case 2 — an unauthorized ADMIT of a newcomer the join policy does not allow. This committee's genesis
  436: %% has no `can_join` clause (no genesis ontology), so admission is fail-closed: the verdict re-proves
  437: %% `can_join` and it fails, rejecting the admit. No honest support, the view advances, the committee keeps four.
  438: byzantine_admit_rejected(Config) ->
  439:     {NewPub, _} = quod_identity:generate(),
  440:     Evil = tx([{assert, {{peer_admitted, NewPub, "10.9.9.9", 9000, NewPub}, true}}]),
  441:     assert_membership_proposal_skipped(Config, Evil).
  442: 
  443: %% Kill the next slot's leader BEFORE it proposes: the slot cannot commit (no
  444: %% proposer), so the three live validators complain and a ⅔ complaint cert
  445: %% skips it. Each origin retains its exact signed submission and places it on
  446: %% the rotated proposer without returning a public slot-closure retry.
  447: leader_failover(Config) ->
  448:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  449:     H = synced_height(Nodes),
  450:     V = protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)),
  451:     {DeadPeer, DeadPub} = leader_peer(V, Config),
  452:     ok   = peer:stop(DeadPeer),
  453:     Live = [N || {_, P} = N <- Nodes, P =/= DeadPub],
  454:     %% Submit on every live validator so all three arm demand for slot V. None
  455:     %% can commit there because its proposer is dead; all must survive the skip.
  456:     W = {assertz, {failover, done, yes}},
  457:     Parent = self(),
  458:     Tags =
  459:         [begin
  460:              Tag = {dead_leader_submit, P},
  461:              _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {Tag, prove(P, W)} end),
  462:              Tag
  463:          end || {P, _} <- Live],
  464:     %% The dead leader cannot notarize V. A complaint quorum advances the
  465:     %% protocol without manufacturing a material ledger row.
  466:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> protocol_view(P) > V end, 20000)) || {P, _} <- Live ],
  467:     Results =
  468:         [receive {Tag, Result} -> Result
  469:          after 15000 ->
  470:              ct:fail({retained_submission_did_not_finish, Tag})
  471:          end || Tag <- Tags],
  472:     ?assert(lists:all(fun(Result) -> match_ok(Result) end, Results)),
  473:     {ProbePeer, _} = hd(Live),
  474:     ?assert(eventually(
  475:               fun() ->
  476:                       match_ok(
  477:                         prove(ProbePeer, {failover, done, {'X'}}))
  478:               end, 10000)),
  479:     H1 = synced_height(Live),
  480:     ?assert(H1 > H),
  481:     {NextLeader, _} = hd(Live),
  482:     After = {assertz, {failover, after_rotation, yes}},
  483:     ?assert(eventually(
  484:               fun() -> ordinary_write_ok(prove(NextLeader, After)) end,
  485:               20000)),
  486:     [ begin
  487:           ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(P) >= H1 + 1 end, 15000)),
  488:           ?assert(eventually(
  489:                     fun() ->
  490:                             match_ok(
  491:                               prove(P, {failover, done, {'X'}}))
  492:                     end, 10000)),
  493:           ?assert(eventually(
  494:                     fun() ->
  495:                             match_ok(
  496:                               prove(P, {failover, after_rotation, {'X'}}))
  497:                     end, 10000))
  498:       end || {P, _} <- Live ],
  499:     ?assert(eventually(
  500:               fun() -> length(lists:usort([slot(P) || {P, _} <- Live])) =:= 1 end,
  501:               10000)).
  502: 
  503: %% With two of four validators absent, neither support nor complaint can form
  504: %% a quorum. Real timeout votes remain durable; restoring the missing members
  505: %% must recover the retained write without changing those votes or resubmitting.
  506: over_fault_restart_recovers(Config) ->
  507:     Ns = <<"simplex:over-f-recovery">>,
  508:     Ports = [15830, 15831, 15832, 15833],
  509:     Keys = [quod_identity:generate() || _ <- Ports],
  510:     Addrs = [{P, {"127.0.0.1", Port}} || {{P, _}, Port} <- lists:zip(Keys, Ports)],
  511:     put(over_f_nodes, []),
  512:     try
  513:         {Nodes0, BootModes, _GenesisHash} =
  514:             start_founding_committee(
  515:               Ns, "sxr_", Ports, Keys, Addrs, Config, tracked),
  516:         ?assert(eventually(
  517:                   fun() ->
  518:                           lists:all(
  519:                             fun({P, _}) ->
  520:                                     maps:get(syncing, status(P, Ns), true) =:= false
  521:                             end, Nodes0)
  522:                   end, 30000)),
  523: 
  524:         %% Create durable, non-genesis history before the outage. Restarting the stopped peers must now
  525:         %% reopen and extend their existing ledgers, not accidentally pass as fresh empty/catch-up boots.
  526:         HBase = synced_height(Nodes0, Ns),
  527:         {BaselineLeader, _} =
  528:             lists:keyfind(leader_for(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes0), Ns), Nodes0), 2, Nodes0),
  529:         ?assert(eventually(
  530:                   fun() ->
  531:                           ordinary_write_ok(
  532:                             prove(BaselineLeader, Ns,
  533:                                   {assertz, {before_over_f, durable}}))
  534:                   end,
  535:                   20000)),
  536:         ?assert(eventually(
  537:                   fun() -> lists:all(fun({P, _}) -> slot(P, Ns) >= HBase + 1 end, Nodes0) end,
  538:                   20000)),
  539:         H0 = synced_height(Nodes0, Ns),
  540:         ?assert(H0 >= 2),
  541: 
  542:         LeaderPub = leader_for(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes0), Ns), Nodes0),
  543:         {LeaderPeer, LeaderPub} = lists:keyfind(LeaderPub, 2, Nodes0),
  544:         {SurvivorPeer, _} = Survivor =
  545:             hd([N || N <- Nodes0, N =/= {LeaderPeer, LeaderPub}]),
  546:         Down = [N || N <- Nodes0,
  547:                      N =/= {LeaderPeer, LeaderPub}, N =/= Survivor],
  548:         LeaderTimeouts0 = maps:get(
  549:                           progress_timeouts,
  550:                           peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, stats, [Ns]), 0),
  551:         SurvivorTimeouts0 = maps:get(
  552:                             progress_timeouts,
  553:                             peer:call(SurvivorPeer, quod_simplex, stats, [Ns]), 0),
  554:         [ok = peer:stop(P) || {P, _} <- Down],
  555: 
  556:         %% The write reaches the real leader with only 2/4 validators alive. Its
  557:         %% caller may report a typed unknown while quorum is absent; it must
  558:         %% never receive a retry/redirect that would discard retained custody.
  559:         Parent = self(),
  560:         WriteTag = make_ref(),
  561:         _ = spawn(
  562:               fun() ->
  563:                       Parent !
  564:                           {WriteTag,
  565:                            prove(LeaderPeer, Ns,
  566:                                  {assertz, {over_f, recovered}})}
  567:               end),
  568:         ?assert(eventually(
  569:                   fun() ->
  570:                           LeaderStats = peer:call(
  571:                                           LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, stats, [Ns]),
  572:                           SurvivorStats = peer:call(
  573:                                             SurvivorPeer, quod_simplex, stats, [Ns]),
  574:                           maps:get(progress_timeouts, LeaderStats, 0) > LeaderTimeouts0
  575:                               andalso maps:get(progress_timeouts, SurvivorStats, 0)
  576:                                       > SurvivorTimeouts0
  577:                               andalso maps:get(head_complaint_signed, LeaderStats, 0) =:= 1
  578:                               andalso maps:get(head_complaint_signed, SurvivorStats, 0) =:= 1
  579:                               andalso slot(LeaderPeer, Ns) =:= H0
  580:                               andalso slot(SurvivorPeer, Ns) =:= H0
  581:                   end, ?DELTA_MS * 3)),
  582: 
  583:         DownPubs = [Pub || {_P, Pub} <- Down],
  584:         Restarted = [start_tracked_member(
  585:                        Ns, "sxr_", Port, Key, Addrs,
  586:                        maps:get(Pub, BootModes), Config)
  587:                      || {Port, {Pub, _} = Key} <- lists:zip(Ports, Keys),
  588:                         lists:member(Pub, DownPubs)],
  589:         Nodes1 = [N || N <- Nodes0, not lists:member(element(2, N), DownPubs)] ++ Restarted,
  590:         ?assert(eventually(
  591:                   fun() ->
  592:                           lists:all(fun({P, _}) -> slot(P, Ns) >= H0 + 1 end, Nodes1)
  593:                               andalso lists:all(
  594:                                         fun({P, _}) ->
  595:                                                 match_ok(prove(P, Ns, {over_f, {'X'}}))
  596:                                         end, Nodes1)
  597:                   end, 45000)),
  598:         InterruptedResult =
  599:             receive
  600:                 {WriteTag, Result} ->
  601:                     Result
  602:             after 40000 ->
  603:                 ct:fail(interrupted_write_caller_did_not_finish)
  604:             end,
  605:         case InterruptedResult of
  606:             {ok, _, _} ->
  607:                 ok;
  608:             {error, {outcome_unknown,
  609:                      {transaction, Ns, <<_:256>>, <<_:256>>}}} ->
  610:                 ok;
  611:             OtherInterrupted ->
  612:                 ct:fail(
  613:                   {invalid_interrupted_write_result, OtherInterrupted})
  614:         end,
  615: 
  616:         H1 = synced_height(Nodes1, Ns),
  617:         {NextLeader, _} = lists:keyfind(leader_for(protocol_view(peer1(Nodes1), Ns), Nodes1), 2, Nodes1),
  618:         NextResult = prove(NextLeader, Ns, {assertz, {after_over_f, live}}),
  619:         case NextResult of
  620:             {ok, [_ | _], _} -> ok;
  621:             _ ->
  622:                 ct:pal("post-recovery write ~p; current owners ~p", [NextResult,
  623:                     [{Pub, catch peer:call(P, ?MODULE, recovery_diagnostics,
  624:                                           [Ns, NextResult])}
  625:                      || {P, Pub} <- Nodes1]]),
  626:                 ct:fail({post_recovery_write, NextResult})
  627:         end,
  628:         ?assert(eventually(
  629:                   fun() -> lists:all(fun({P, _}) -> slot(P, Ns) >= H1 + 1 end, Nodes1) end,
  630:                   20000))
  631:     catch
  632:         Class:Reason:Stack ->
  633:             ct:pal("over-f failure ~p:~p; owners ~p", [Class, Reason,
  634:                 [{Pub, catch peer:call(P, ?MODULE, recovery_diagnostics, [Ns, none])}
  635:                  || {P, Pub} <- get(over_f_nodes), is_process_alive(P)]]),
  636:             erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  637:     after
  638:         %% Every successfully-started peer is registered immediately, so setup/restart failures cannot leak
  639:         %% earlier OS nodes. Duplicate/stopped entries are harmless under catch.
  640:         Tracked = case erase(over_f_nodes) of undefined -> []; L -> L end,
  641:         _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || {P, _} <- Tracked]
  642:     end.
  643: 
  644: recovery_diagnostics(Ns, Result) ->
  645:     Pid = quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, Ns}),
  646:     {_, State} = sys:get_state(Pid),
  647:     #{stats => quod_simplex:stats(Ns),
  648:       position => quod_simplex:test_protocol_position(State),
  649:       pools => quod_simplex:test_engine_pool_sizes(State),
  650:       progress => quod_simplex:test_progress(State),
  651:       custody => quod_simplex:test_custody(State),
  652:       author_custody => quod_simplex:test_custody_authors(State),
  653:       process => process_info(Pid, [current_stacktrace, message_queue_len]),
  654:       outcome => case Result of
  655:           {error, {outcome_unknown, Tx}} -> quod_prolog:local_outcome(Ns, Tx);
  656:           _ -> none
  657:       end}.
  658: 
  659: %% One valid removal sent while its current proposer is down. The caller is
  660: %% invoked once; a view change must preserve the exact signed transaction.
  661: membership_survives_leader_loss(Config) ->
  662:     Ns = <<"simplex:membership-leader-loss">>,
  663:     Ports = [15834, 15835, 15836, 15837],
  664:     Keys = [quod_identity:generate() || _ <- Ports],
  665:     Addrs = [{Pub, {"127.0.0.1", Port}} || {{Pub, _}, Port} <- lists:zip(Keys, Ports)],
  666:     put(over_f_nodes, []),
  667:     try
  668:         {Nodes, _, _} = start_founding_committee(
  669:             Ns, "sxm_", Ports, Keys, Addrs, Config, tracked),
  670:         [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> match_ok(prove(P, Ns, true)) end, 10000))
  671:           || {P, _} <- Nodes ],
  672:         View = protocol_view(peer1(Nodes), Ns),
  673:         {Dead, DeadPub} = lists:keyfind(leader_for(View, Nodes), 2, Nodes),
  674:         Live = [N || N <- Nodes, N =/= {Dead, DeadPub}],
  675:         ok = peer:stop(Dead),
  676:         {Origin, _} = hd(Live),
  677:         Result = prove(Origin, Ns, {remove, DeadPub}),
  678:         ct:pal("membership leader-loss result ~p, survivor progress ~p", [Result,
  679:             [{Pub, peer:call(P, quod_simplex, stats, [Ns])} || {P, Pub} <- Live]]),
  680:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, _}, Result),
  681:         [ ?assert(eventually(fun() ->
  682:             S = status(P, Ns),
  683:             maps:get(committee, S, []) =:= lists:sort(pubs(Live))
  684:               andalso maps:get(committed, S, 0) =:= 2
  685:         end, 15000)) || {P, _} <- Live ]
  686:     after
  687:         Tracked = case erase(over_f_nodes) of undefined -> []; L -> L end,
  688:         _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || {P, _} <- Tracked]
  689:     end.
  690: 
  691: %%%===================================================================
  692: %%% helpers
  693: %%%===================================================================
  694: 
  695: %% Inject `Evil` (a #transaction) as a crafted proposal for the next slot, from the REAL slot leader's
  696: %% node, and assert every node advances past the view with the committee unchanged and the namespace still live.
  697: assert_membership_proposal_skipped(Config, Evil) ->
  698:     Nodes  = ?config(nodes, Config),
  699:     H      = synced_height(Nodes),
  700:     V      = protocol_view(peer1(Nodes)),
  701:     {LeaderPeer, LeaderPub} = leader_peer(V, Config),
  702:     Before  = committee(peer1(Nodes)),
  703:     RejBefore = rejects_total(Nodes),   %% cumulative — assert it GROWS for THIS proposal (not a stale count)
  704:     %% craft the block for slot V and send it to every follower over the {log, Ns} channel FROM the leader's
  705:     %% node — authenticated as the leader (so on_propose's leader-check passes), but bypassing the leader's
  706:     %% own statem (a transport-level send). Timestamp margin keeps it monotonic vs the last committed block.
  707:     Ts    = erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 1000,
  708:     Identity = maps:get(LeaderPub, ?config(identities, Config)),
  709:     Anchor = peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  710:     Unsigned = quod_transaction:bind_id(
  711:                  {?NS, Anchor},
  712:                  Evil#transaction{author = LeaderPub,
  713:                                   author_seq = (1 bsl 60) + V, sig = none}),
  714:     Status = peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]),
  715:     {ok, Binding} = quod_simplex:history_binding(
  716:                       {?NS, Anchor}, LeaderPub,
  717:                       maps:get(history_projection, Status)),
  718:     {ok, SignedEvil} = quod_transaction:sign(Binding, Unsigned, Identity),
  719:     %% Adversarial semantics, but a valid canonical envelope: the proposal must
  720:     %% reach validator rejection rather than fail locally before transmission.
  721:     #{era := Era, view := V, parent := ParentRef} =
  722:         quod_ct:peer_protocol_position(LeaderPeer, ?NS),
  723:     {ok, Block} = quod_ledger:new_block({Era, V}, ParentRef, maps:get(material_height, quod_ct:peer_protocol_position(LeaderPeer, ?NS)) + 1, {batch, [SignedEvil]}, Ts),
  724:     Chan  = term_to_binary({log, ?NS}, [deterministic]),
  725:     Frame = quod_simplex:encode(?NS, {propose, Block, []}),
  726:     _ = [peer:call(LeaderPeer, quod_quic, send, [Fpub, Chan, Frame])
  727:          || {_, Fpub} <- Nodes, Fpub =/= LeaderPub],
  728:     %% Rejection advances the protocol only; no fabricated ledger row.
  729:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> protocol_view(P) > V end, 20000)) || {P, _} <- Nodes ],
  730:     ?assertEqual([H], lists:usort([slot(P) || {P, _} <- Nodes])),
  731:     %% the committee is unchanged (the change never committed) and the fleet's reject counter GREW for THIS
  732:     %% proposal — a delta, not a stale cumulative count from an earlier ordered test (false-green guard)
  733:     ?assertEqual(Before, committee(peer1(Nodes))),
  734:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> rejects_total(Nodes) > RejBefore end, 5000)),
  735:     %% the namespace is not wedged: the rotated leader for V+1 commits an honest write
  736:     {L, _} = leader_peer(V + 1, Config),
  737:     ?assert(eventually(
  738:               fun() ->
  739:                       ordinary_write_ok(
  740:                         prove(L, {assertz, {after_byzantine, V}}))
  741:               end, 20000)),
  742:     [ ?assert(eventually(fun() -> slot(P) =:= H + 1 end, 15000)) || {P, _} <- Nodes ].
  743: 
  744: %% a raw #transaction carrying an arbitrary diff (the Byzantine submitter path — no admit/remove predicate)
  745: tx(Diff) ->
  746:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal(byzantine_membership_change),
  747:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
  748:     #transaction{tx_id = <<>>, origin = {?NS, <<0:256>>},
  749:                  proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = <<0:256>>,
  750:                  goal = Goal, result = Result, diff = Diff,
  751:                  read_check = #{}, author = <<0:256>>, sig = none}.
  752: 
  753: committee(Peer)          -> maps:get(committee, status(Peer), []).
  754: membership_rejects(Peer) -> maps:get(membership_rejects, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, stats, [?NS]), 0).
  755: rejects_total(Nodes)     -> lists:sum([membership_rejects(P) || {P, _} <- Nodes]).
  756: 
  757: pubs(Nodes) -> [P || {_, P} <- Nodes].
  758: peer1(Nodes) -> element(1, hd(Nodes)).
  759: 
  760: %% Wait until EVERY node reports the same committed height, then return it. The committee is quiescent
  761: %% between the (ordered) tests, so once they agree the height is stable — this avoids picking a leader
  762: %% off a node that is a beat behind (a non-leader whose own next slot it would still lead).
  763: synced_height(Nodes) ->
  764:     ?assert(eventually(fun() -> length(lists:usort([slot(P) || {P, _} <- Nodes])) =:= 1 end, 10000)),
  765:     slot(peer1(Nodes)).
  766: 
  767: synced_height(Nodes, Ns) ->
  768:     ?assert(eventually(
  769:               fun() -> length(lists:usort([slot(P, Ns) || {P, _} <- Nodes])) =:= 1 end,
  770:               15000)),
  771:     slot(peer1(Nodes), Ns).
  772: 
  773: %% The round-robin leader for a slot — MUST match quod_simplex:leader/2 (sorted set, (Slot-1) rem N).
  774: leader_for(Slot, Nodes) ->
  775:     quod_simplex:leader(Slot, pubs(Nodes)).
  776: 
  777: relay_only_origin(Floor, Nodes) ->
  778:     PossibleLeaders =
  779:         [leader_for(Floor, Nodes), leader_for(Floor + 1, Nodes)],
  780:     hd([Node || {_, Pub} = Node <- Nodes,
  781:                 not lists:member(Pub, PossibleLeaders)]).
  782: 
  783: leader_peer(Slot, Config) ->
  784:     Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
  785:     lists:keyfind(leader_for(Slot, Nodes), 2, Nodes).
  786: 
  787: protocol_view(Peer) -> protocol_view(Peer, ?NS).
  788: protocol_view(Peer, Ns) -> maps:get(protocol_view, status(Peer, Ns), -1).
  789: 
  790: status(Peer) -> peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]).
  791: status(Peer, Ns) -> peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]).
  792: %% -1 (not a valid slot) if status/1 hits its internal timeout and returns #{} — a clean, retryable
  793: %% miss instead of a {badkey,slot} crash. Numeric so `>= V` in eventually stays false (an atom sentinel
  794: %% would sort above integers in Erlang term order and spuriously satisfy it).
  795: slot(Peer) -> maps:get(slot, status(Peer), -1).
  796: slot(Peer, Ns) -> maps:get(slot, status(Peer, Ns), -1).
  797: prove(Peer, Goal) -> quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, ?NS, Goal).
  798: prove(Peer, Ns, Goal) -> quod_ct:peer_prove(Peer, Ns, Goal).
